guide_line: Name the element from its configuration.
steps: Add every superscript. That sum is Z for a neutral atom.
A noble-gas core counts too: He 2, Ne 10, Ar 18, Kr 36.
The element with that atomic number is the answer.
Type the element name, such as iron.

similar_problem.hint: Ne is 10. Add the two 3s electrons.

hints: Include the noble-gas core in the electron count.
